headline: Recommended paying two pothole claims of $275.00 and $300.00, and recommended denying a $1,349.08 tire claim.
summary: Napoleon Gonsalves and Nicholas Jensen were recommended for payment on pothole damage claims. Pericles Vieira's tire claim was referred to JR Vinagro Construction Corporation. In closed session on pending litigation, councilors discussed the Wayne Lema lawsuit and gave the city solicitor instructions on it.
decisions: Recommended paying Napoleon Gonsalves $275.00 and Nicholas Jensen $300.00 for pothole damage, 2-0.
Recommended denying Pericles Vieira's $1,349.08 tire claim and referring it to JR Vinagro Construction Corporation, 2-0.
Gave the city solicitor instructions on the Wayne Lema lawsuit (C.A. No.: PC-2022-06919).

Wayne Lema v. City of Pawtucket (C.A. No.: PC-2022-06919)
plain_text:
PAWTUCKET CITY COUNCIL 
COMMITTEE ON CLAIMS AND PENDING SUITS 
November 10, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits was held Tuesday, November 10, 2026, 
at 6:11 p.m., in the City Council Conference Room, Room 140, 100 Freight Street, Pawtucket, RI. 
 
Present – Councilor Rubio, Chair; and Councilor Araujo. 
 
Absent – Councilor Moreno. 
 
Councilor Rubio presided.  
 
Also present were Frank J. Milos, Jr., Esq., City Solicitor; Pericles Vieira, Claimant; and Napoleon 
Gonsalves, Claimant. 
 
The Committee conducted a public input period, at which there were no speakers. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
RECOMMENDED TO BE PAID, AS FOLLOWS: 
 
AYES — Councilor Rubio, Chair; and Councilor Araujo. 
 
NOES — 0. 
 
Napoleon Gonsalves – $275.00 (Pothole) 
 
Nicholas Jensen – $300.00 (Pothole) 
 
 
 
RECOMMENDED TO BE DENIED  AND REFERRED TO JR VINAGRO CONSTRUCTION 
CORPORATION, AS FOLLOWS: 
 
AYES — Councilor Rubio, Chair; and Councilor Araujo. 
 
NOES — 0. 
 
Pericles Vieira – $1,349.08 (Tire) 
 
 
THE COMMITTEE TOOK UP THE FOLLOWING: 
 
Communication from Frank J. Milos Jr., Esq., City Solicitor, to Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, City 
Clerk, (City Council’s Committee on Claims and Pending Suits Meeting of November 10, 2026) 
 
This communication was READ AND ORDERED FILED.
Committee on Claims and Pending Suits 
November 10, 2026 
Page 2 
 
Upon unanimous consent of the Committee, the Committee entered into Executive Session at 6:29 
p.m., pursuant to §42 -46-4 and §42-46-5 (A)(2) of the General Laws of Rhode Island regarding 
pending litigation, on a roll call vote, as follows: 
 
AYES — Councilor Rubio, Chair; and Councilor Araujo. 
 
NOES — 0. 
 
 
The Committee discussed the following claim: 
 
Wayne Lema v. City of Pawtucket (C.A. No.: PC-2022-06919) 
 
 
The Committee returned to open session at 6:36 p.m., on a roll call vote, as follows: 
 
AYES — Councilor Rubio, Chair; and Councilor Araujo. 
 
NOES — 0. 
 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor Araujo, seconded by Councilor Rubio, the minutes of the meeting 
held in executive session were sealed on a roll call vote, as follows: 
 
AYES — Councilor Rubio, Chair; and Councilor Araujo. 
 
NOES — 0. 
 
 
The committee provided the city solicitor with instructions on th e claim of Wayne Lema v. City 
of Pawtucket (C.A. No.: PC-2022-06919) 
 
 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 6:38 p.m. 
 
 
 
Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, Clerk  
Pawtucket City Council
